pages.title: Start Here: 3 Fast-Track Paths to Production Memory
pages.lead: Deploying persistent memory takes under five minutes with PiyAPI REST endpoints or language SDKs.

sections.heading: Path 1: Store & Recall Memory in 2 Steps
paragraphs: Initialize your client with your live API key, store unstructured conversation facts, and perform multi-signal hybrid recall (dense vector + BM25 trigram fused with RRF_K=30).

sections.heading: Path 2: Strict Multi-Tenant Namespace Isolation
paragraphs: For SaaS applications with multi-tenant architectures, pass the X-Namespace-Prefix header on every request to guarantee zero scope leakage across client organizations.

sections.heading: Path 3: Local Ollama & Air-Gapped Fallback
paragraphs: When running in privacy-sensitive or edge environments, use the BYOK routing engine or run local containers with pgvector and Ollama embeddings.

code_blocks.title: TypeScript / Node.js — Minimal Companion Loop
cURL — Namespace Scoping
code_blocks.code:
curl -X POST https://api.piyapi.cloud/api/v1/memories \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR API KEY" \
  -H "X-Namespace-Prefix: tenant_acme_corp" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "content": "Enterprise security policy mandates 90-day key rotations.",
    "tags": ["security", "policy"]
  }'

pages.title: Build a Companion with Negentro & PiyAPI
pages.breadcrumb: Cookbooks / Companion Playbooks / Build a Companion
pages.lead: Step-by-step guide to giving an AI assistant persistent long-term memory across sessions.

sections.heading: System Architecture
paragraphs: A persistent AI companion requires three synchronized subsystems: (1) Fact Extraction from user conversations, (2) Hybrid Vector + BM25 Storage with bitemporal timestamps, and (3) Context Window Injection during generation.

code_blocks.title: Python — End-to-End Companion Loop
code_blocks.code:
from piyapi_memory import PiyAPIClient

client = PiyAPIClient(api_key="YOUR API KEY")

def chat_turn(user_id: str, prompt: str) -> str:
    # Step 1: Recall relevant facts using hybrid RRF scoring
    context_records = client.search.query(
        query=prompt,
        filter={"metadata.user_id": user_id},
        limit=4
    )
    
    # Step 2: Format context injection
    memory_context = "\n".join([f"- {r['content']}" for r in context_records['results']])
    
    # Step 3: Run LLM inference with augmented context
    system_prompt = f"""You are a helpful personal companion.
User Background & Memories:
{memory_context}"""
    
    # Step 4: After replying, mine new facts for persistence
    client.memories.create(
        content=prompt,
        tags=["conversation"],
        metadata={"user_id": user_id}
    )
    return "Response generated with active context."

pages.title: Self-Hosted AI Companion with Ollama & pgvector
pages.lead: Run an air-gapped cognitive memory engine entirely on local hardware.

code_blocks.title: docker-compose.yml
code_blocks.code:
version: '3.8'
services:
  piyapi-engine:
    image: piyapi/cognitive-engine:latest
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://piyapi:secret@postgres:5432/piyapi_db
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama
      - OLLAMA_HOST=http://host.docker.internal:11434
    depends_on:
      - postgres
      - redis

  postgres:
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_DB=piyapi_db
      - POSTGRES_USER=piyapi
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=secret

sections.heading: Transcript Ingestion Pipeline
paragraphs: Extract transcripts from YouTube and index each chapter with timestamp metadata:

code_blocks.title: Python — YouTube Ingestion
code_blocks.code:
from youtube_transcript_api import YouTubeTranscriptApi
from piyapi_memory import PiyAPIClient

client = PiyAPIClient(api_key="sk_live_prod_key_here")

def index_youtube_video(video_id: str, title: str):
    transcript = YouTubeTranscriptApi.get_transcript(video_id)
    full_text = " ".join([t['text'] for t in transcript[:20]])
    
    client.memories.create(
        content=f"Video '{title}': {full_text}",
        tags=["youtube", "research-transcript"],
        metadata={"video_id": video_id, "title": title}
    )
    print("Video indexed successfully.")

pages.title: AWS Bedrock with Persistent Memory
pages.lead: Combine AWS Bedrock foundation models with PiyAPI hybrid search and pgvector memory stores.

code_blocks.title: Python — Bedrock Converse Loop
code_blocks.code:
import boto3
from piyapi_memory import PiyAPIClient

bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime', region_name='us-east-1')
piyapi = PiyAPIClient(api_key="sk_live_prod_key_here")

def generate_with_bedrock(user_id: str, prompt: str):
    # 1. Retrieve user memory
    mems = piyapi.memories.search(query=prompt, user_id=user_id, limit=3)
    context = "\n".join([m['content'] for m in mems])
    
    # 2. Invoke Bedrock Converse API
    response = bedrock.converse(
        modelId="anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620-v1:0",
        messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": f"Context:\n{context}\n\nQuestion: {prompt}"}]}]
    )
    return response['output']['message']['content'][0]['text']
